card.name: Seizures and 'seen' in opioid warnings
card.fires_on: The word 'seizures' after 'increase the frequency of' in opioid seizure-disorder warnings, and 'seen' in 'mydriasis rather than miosis may be seen' in overdose text.

modes.label: Seizure frequency warning
modes.description: 'seizures' right after 'may increase the frequency of' in opioid tablet or syrup labels.
modes.example: may increase the frequency of<< seizures>> in patients with seizure disorders, and may

modes.label: Mydriasis may be seen
modes.description: 'seen' after 'may be' in the overdose sentence about mydriasis with hypoxia.
modes.example: Marked mydriasis rather than miosis may be<< seen>> with hypoxia in overdose situations.

card.plain: It marks a couple of fixed phrases from opioid label warnings: 'frequency of seizures' and 'may be seen'.
